Do you, O Savyasachin, shoot the same sort of weapon again and again.” And thus being asked by his brother, The arrows, coming out of the Savyasachin Gandiva, resembled terrible snakes or the sun's rays shoot another like the one he used before and by that the energetic Partha covered all the cardinal and subsidiary points of ten compass.

sa: ब्रह्मास्त्रमण्यवाप्यैतदुपदेशात् पितुस्तव। क्षत्रधर्मान्महाबाहुर्नाकम्पत धनंजयः॥
en: Having obtained even the Brahma weapon through your fathers instructions the powerful Dhananjaya did not deviate from a Kshatriya's duties.

sa: सर्वाण्येतानि कौन्तेय विद्यन्ते मनुजर्षभ। साध्वाचारप्रवृत्तानां चातुराश्रम्यकारिणाम्॥
en: All the merits, O son of Kunti, which accrue to persons practising the duties of the four modes of life, are partaken of, O foremost of men, by righteous kings.

sa: मूर्यो ह्यधिकृतोऽर्थेषु कार्याणामविशारदः। प्रजाः क्लिश्नात्ययोगेन कामक्रोधसमन्वितः॥
en: Possessed of lust and anger and raw in the transaction of business, foolish persons, if vested with power in matters of Profit, always oppress the people by various mischievous means,

sa: यः सुपर्णा यजुर्नाम च्छन्दोगात्रस्त्रिवृच्छिराः। रथन्तरं वृहत् साम तस्मै स्तोत्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You are the Purusha described in the Vedas. Your name is Yajus. The Vedic metres are your limbs. The sacrifices laid down in the three Vedas forın your three heads. The great sacrifices called Rathantara is your voice expressing your gratification. Salutations to you in your form of sacred hymns.

sa: अनङ्गपुत्रोऽतिबलो नीतिमानभिगम्य वै। प्रतिपेदे महाराज्यमथेन्द्रियवशोऽभवत्॥
en: Ananga beget a son named Atibala, wellread in politics. Obtaining extensive empire after the death of his father, he became a slave of his passions.

sa: ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिमित्राणि व्यापन्नानि युधिष्ठिर। समभ्युद्धरमाणस्य दीक्षाश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
en: That king, O Yudhishthira, who saves from distress, to the best of his ability, the kinsmen and relatives and friends, attains to the object of the Vanaprastha mode of life.

sa: यैरात्मभूतैर्भगवान् पार्वत्य च महेश्वरः॥ महाभूतगणैभुते भूतभव्यभवत्प्रभुः।
en: The divine Maheshvara, that lord of the past, the present, and the future, as also Parvati, eat with those various clans of powerful beings that partake of their own nature.

sa: दिष्ट्या मुक्तस्तु संग्रामादस्माल्लोकभयंकरात्। क्षत्रधर्मरतश्चापि कच्चिन्मोदसि पाण्डव॥
en: By dint of good fortune, you have escaped alive from this dreadful battle. Ever abiding by the duties of a Kshatriya, why do you not rejoice, O son of Pandu?

sa: श्रेणीमुख्योपजायेषु वल्लभानुनयेषु च। अमात्यान् परिरक्षेत भेदसंघातयोरपि॥
en: He should take care to create dissension among the leaders of sects and of conciliating those that are dear to him. He should protect his ministers from dissension and destruction,

sa: लोकस्य सीमन्तकरी मर्यादा लोकभाविनी। सम्यड्नीता दण्डनीतिर्यथा माता यथा पिता॥
en: The science of punishment, which establishes all men in the observance of their respective duties, which is the basis of all healthy distinctions, and which truly keeps up the world and sets it agoing if properly administered, protects all men like parents protecting their children.

sa: जलवांस्तृणवान् मार्गः समो गम्यः प्रशस्यते। चारैः सुविदिताभ्यासः कुशलैर्वनगोचरैः॥
en: That road which has profuse water and grass along it, which is level and easy of march, should be taken. The regions lying near the road should previously be reconnoitred through skilful spies having an intimate knowledge of the woods.

sa: युद्धदीक्षां प्रविश्याजौ रणयज्ञं वितत्य च। हुत्वाऽऽत्मानममित्राग्नौ प्राप चावभृथं यशः॥
en: Having made all possible arrangements for the Sacrifice of battle, and having performed the initiatory rites on the field, and lastly, having poured his life as a libation upon the fire of foes, Duryodhana had duly completed his Sacrifice by the final ablutions of glory!"

sa: अगाधे सुमहाघोरे सर्वभूतभयंकरे॥ त्रितस्ततो महाराज कूपस्थो मुनिसत्तमः।
en: That hole was deep and terrible and capable of striking terror to all creatures. Then Trita, O king, that best of ascetics, from within that hole, began to bewail. His two brothers heard his cries.

sa: न च राज्यसमो धर्मः कश्चिदस्ति परंतप। धर्मः संशब्दितो राज्ञामापदर्थमतोऽन्यथा।॥
en: There is nothing, O scorcher of foes, which yields greater merit to a king than the possession of a kingdom. It is sinful for a king to oppress his subjects with heavy taxes at ordinary times. In a season of distress, it is quite different.

sa: कुक्कुटारावबहुलं गर्दभध्वनिनादितम्। उद्घोषद्भिः खरैर्वाक्यैः कलहद्भिः परस्परम्॥
en: The place was resonant with the loud crowing of cocks and hens and the discordant bray of asses. The inhabitants quarrelled with one another, uttering harsh words in shrill voices.

sa: न तद्धरेद् यत् पुनराहरेत् परः। न तं हन्याद् यस्य शिरो न पातयेत्॥
en: The uncrossable should not be sought to be crossed. That which the enemy would be able to recover should not be snatched from him. One should not try to dig at all if by digging one could get at the root of the thing for which one digs. One should never strike him whose head one would not cut off.

sa: शस्त्राग्रेष्वभवज्ज्वाला नेत्राण्याहत्य वर्षती। शिरःस्वलीयन्त भृशं काकोलूकाश्च केतुषु॥
en: Blazing flames came out from the points of weapons, dazzling the eyes of the warriors. Crows and owls sat upon the heads of the combatants and on the and on the tops of their standards.

sa: अस्मिन्नेवं सूक्ष्मगम्ये मार्गे सद्भिर्निषेविते। कथमर्थमनाढ्यमर्जुन त्वं प्रशंससि॥
en: When there is such a path that is followed by the righteous and that is attainable by Knowledge, why, O Arjuna, do you speak highly of wealth which is full of all sorts of dangers?

sa: ज्वलितैर्निशितैः प्रासशक्त्यृष्टिसपरश्वधैः। शैक्यायसमयैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिघातो भवेद् वसु॥ संख्यासमयविस्तीर्णमभिजातोद्भवं बहु।
en: The strokes inflicted with shining and keen lances and darts and swords and axes, all made of hard iron, from its profuse wealth collected from the respectable people by agreement regarding the amount and period.

sa: चितासहस्रप्रचितं वर्मशस्त्रसमाकुलम्। आपानभूमिं कालस्य तथा भुक्तोज्झितामिव॥
en: interspersed with thousands of funeral pyres and containing masses of armour and weapons, the vast field looked like the drinking site of the Destroyer himself used and left of late.

sa: यथैव दंशमशकं यथा चाण्डपिपीलिकम्। सैव वृत्तिरयज्ञेषु यथा धर्मो विधीयते॥
en: As flies, gnats, and ants are driven off from the bodies of kine and other domestic animals, so should all persons, who are averse to the celebration of sacrifices, should be similarly driven off from the kingdom. This is quite of a piece with morality.

sa: कोकिलस्य वराहस्य मेरो: शून्यस्य वेश्मनः। नटस्य भक्तिमित्रस्य यच्छ्रेचस्तत् समाचरेत्॥
en: Therefore, in doing the work of such persons, one should, without finishing them completely, always keep something undone. A king should do what is for his well-being, imitating a kokila, a boar, the mountains of Meru, and empty chamber, an actor, and a devoted friend.

sa: अल्पमिच्छन्नचपलो मृदुर्दान्तः सुनिश्चितः। ब्रह्मचर्योपपन्नश्च त्वद्विधो नैव शोचति॥
en: A person so mild by nature, of controlled self, and settled conclusions, and observant of Brahmacharya vows, never grieve and never becomes restless from the desire of acquiring from the fear of losing anything insignificant.

sa: तत्र स्थाणुर्महातेजा महापारिषदं प्रभुः॥ मायाशतधरं कामं कामवीर्यं बलान्वितम्।
en: The lord Sthanu, O king, gave to Skanda a companion possessed of great impetuosity, capable of producing a hundred illusions and gifted with might and energy that he could increase at will. And he was the great destroyer if Asuras.

sa: सोऽभ्ययात् पुत्रशोकार्तः पुत्रशोकपरिप्लुतम्। शोचमानं महाराज भ्रातृभिः सहितस्तदा॥
en: Afflicted with grief consequent on the death of his sons, Yudhishthira, O king, accompanied by his brothers, set out for meeting his uncle who was filled with sorrow for the death of his (hundred) sons.

sa: जागर्तव्यमतन्द्रिभ्यामद्यप्रभृति रात्रिषु। योगक्षेमौ हि सीताया वर्तेते लक्ष्मणावयोः॥
en: From to night forth, we shall have to guard her vigilantly, for, O Laksmana, the preservation of what she has as well as the securing to her of what she has not, rests with us.

sa: सर्वर्तुसुखसेव्यानि फलन्त्यन्ये नगोत्तमाः। महार्हमणिचित्राणि फलन्त्यन्ये नगोत्तमाः।४६।।
en: And other excellent trees bear fruits fit to be partaken at all seasons. And other excellent trees bring forth precious beds dight with costly jewels and furnished with variegated covers.

sa: अब्रवीच्च हनूमन्तं विक्रान्तमनिलात्मजम्। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतः प्रभुः सर्ववनौकसाम्॥
en: And convinced as to the ability of that best of monkeys to accomplish the work, Sugrīva, that lord of all the dwellers of the woods, well pleased, spoke to Hanumān, son to the windgod, saying,

sa: सम्पतद्भिः सुरगणैस्तेषां चाभरणौजसा॥ शतादित्यमिवाभाति गगनं गततोयदम्।
en: And eager to witness the spectacle, celestial hosts of immeasurable energy thither and the effulgence of their ornaments, the firmament free from clouds, shone as if with an hundred suns.

sa: सम्मूढनिगमां सर्वां संक्षिप्तविपणापणाम्। प्रच्छन्नशशिनक्षत्रां द्यामिवाम्बुधरैर्युताम्॥
en: With her merchants plunged in grief, and her shops and stalls closed; like the welkin covered with clouds, and having its moon and stars hid.

sa: तैर्दुरात्मभिराविष्टानाश्रमान् प्रजिहासवः। गमनायान्यदेशस्य चोदयन्त्यूषयोऽद्य माम्॥
en: Eager to renounce this asylum infested by those wicked ones, and removing to another place, the sages today have been exhorting me (on the subject).

sa: कन्दमूलफलं हृत्वा यो मां प्रियमिवातिथिम्। भोजयिष्यत्यकर्मण्यमप्रग्रहमनायकम्॥
en: Who procuring Kandas, fruits and roots, will feed me like an welcome guest, incapable of and doing anything and furnishing provisions, and without any one to take care of myself.?

sa: अमितबलपराक्रमा भवन्तो विपुलगुणेषु कुलेषु च प्रसूताः। मनुजपतिसुतां यथा लभध्वं तदधिगुणं पुरुषार्थमारभध्वम्॥
en: Possessed of immeasurable strength and prowess, and sprung from lines crowned with sterling virtues, do you strive manfully in such a glorious way that the king's daughter may be recovered. prowess, and sprung from lines crowned with sterling virtues, do you strive manfully in such a glorious way that the king's daughter may be recovered.

sa: कः कृष्णसर्पमासीनमाशीविषमनागसम्। तुदत्यभिसमापनमङ्गुल्यग्रेण लीलया॥
en: Who is it that with his finger-end has by way of sport hart a black venomous snake that was innocent?

sa: तमतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्र काञ्चनान्तरदर्शनम्। पर्वतः सर्वसौवर्णो धाराप्रस्रवणायुतः॥
en: Passing beyond that foremost of mountains, whose sight betrays the secret of its bowels being freighted with gold, (you shall come upon) the mountain Sarvasauvarna, furnished with fountains and cascades.

sa: अस्माकं विहिता वृत्तिनिसर्गेण च दूरतः। विहिता वृक्षमूले तु वृत्तिश्चरणयोधिनाम्॥
en: Therefore (the Deity) has ordained such food for us as are fraught with the power of making one see from a great distance. And the abode of cocks and others being underneath trees, their sight is limited to the extent which they require to see.

sa: देवायतनचैत्येषु सानभक्ष्याः सदक्षिणाः॥ उपस्थापयितव्याः स्युर्माल्ययोग्याः सदक्षिणाः।
en: In the abodes of the gods and under the Caitya* trees, should be separately placed fragrant blossoms, together with boiled rice and other edibles, and with Daksinās. *The religious fig.

sa: शास्त्रज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च पुरुषान्तरकोविदः। यः प्रग्रहानुग्रहयोर्यथान्यायं विचक्षणः॥
en: He was conversant with the scriptures; and was grateful; and could read the hearts of others. He had sagacity to perceive the seasons for duly showing favour or disfavour. are

sa: अलक्तरसरक्ताभावलक्तरसवर्जितौ। अद्यापि चरणौ तस्याः पद्मकोशसमप्रभौ॥
en: Her feet now without your dye of the liquid lac, but naturally furnished with the roseate hue of the same, are gorgeous like lotus buds.

sa: इत्येवं विलपन् राजा जनौघेनाभिसंवृतः। अपस्नात इवारिष्टं प्रविवेश गृहोत्तमम्॥
en: Thus lamenting, the king surrounded by the multitude, like one that had performed his bath after death, entered that best of cities filled with people enfeebled and smitten with grief, with its streets thinned of men and its stalls closed.

sa: पश्येममचलं भद्रे नानाद्विजगणायुतम्। शिखरैः खमिवोद्विद्धैर्धातुमद्भिर्विभूषितम्॥
en: My gentle one, look but at the hill abounding with flocks of various birds, adorned with summits cleaving the welkin and teeming with mineral substances,

sa: स पर्वतसमुद्राभ्यां बहुमानादवेक्षितः। पूजितश्चोपपन्नाभिराशीर्भिरभिनन्दितः॥
en: Thereat the and the mountain respectfully looked towards him and adored and welcomed him with blessings worthy of the occasion.

sa: पूर्णचन्द्राननः श्यामो गूढजत्रुररिंदमः। आजानुबाहुः पद्माक्षो रामो लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः॥ पूर्वाभिभाषी मधुरः सत्यवादी महाबलः। सौम्यश्च सर्वलोकस्य चन्द्रवत् प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Surely that mighty car warrior, with deepest collar-bones having a countenance resembling the full-moon, sable-hued, repressing his foes, with this arms reaching to his knees and lotuslike eyes, Rāma the elder brother of Laksmana, always speaking first (to a visitor,) suave, truthtelling, endowed with prowess, amiable to all men, and lovely like the moon himself, surely that foremost of men gifted with the strength of a mad elephant, will grace the forests, ranging it around.

sa: पार्थिवान् पार्थिवश्रेष्ठः शिशुपालोऽप्यचेतनः। सर्वान् सर्वात्मना तात नेतुकामो यमक्षयम्॥
en: O best of kings, O child, this Shishupala possesses but little intelligence. He is desirous of taking along (with him) all these monarchs to the abode of Yama through the agency of him who is the soul of this universe.

sa: स च राजा तामुपलभ्य तस्यां सुरतगुणानिवद्धहृदयो लोकत्रयैश्वर्यमिवोपलभ्य हर्षेण वाष्पकलया वाचा प्रणिपत्याभिपूज्य मण्डूकराजमब्रवादनुगृहीतोऽस्मीति।।
en: Having obtained her, the king became greatly enamoured of her for her great accomplishments. Feeling that he had, as it were, obtained the sovereignty of the three worlds, he bowed down his head to the king of the frogs. Honouring him in due form he thus spoke with his voice choked with tears of joy, "I have been much favoured."

sa: शरण्यं सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम्। दिव्यमाश्रयणीयं तमाश्रमं श्रमनाशनम्॥
en: It was the refuge of all creatures, it echoed with the recitations of the Vedas. It was heavenly and a fit place for a holy hermitage; it destroyed all fatigue.

sa: कदम्बसर्जार्जुनकर्णिकारैः। तपात्यये पुष्पधरैरुपेतं महावनं राष्ट्रपतिर्ददर्श॥
en: The king saw that huge forest covered, at the end of summer, with Shalas palms, mangoes, Madhukas, Nipas, Kadambas, Sarjas, Arjunas, Karnikaras clothed with flowers;

sa: आरिराधयिषुर्गङ्गां तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषः। सोऽपश्यत नरश्रेष्ठ हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम्॥ शृङ्गैर्बहुविधाकारैर्धातुमद्भिरलंकृतम्। पवनालम्बिभिर्मेधैः परिषिक्तं समन्ततः॥
en: O foremost of men, being cleansed of his sins by asceticism, he visited that best of mountains Himalayas in order to worship Ganga. (He saw it) adorned with peaks of various forms and with many mineral wealth; all its sides were besprinkled with drops of rain from the clouds which were floating on the wind.

sa: शयानममितात्मानं पद्मोत्पलनिकेतनम्। त्वमेकः सर्वभूतेशं ब्रह्माणमुपतिष्ठसि।॥
en: When (at such a period) the lord of creatures takes his seat on a lotus and sleeps there then you alone remain to worship him.

sa: तद् वृक्षयुद्धमभवन्महीरुहविनाशनम्। वालिसुग्रीवयोर्धात्रोः पुरा स्त्रीकाक्षिणोर्यथा॥
en: Thus went on that battle with trees, destructive of plants like that between the two brothers Bali and Sugriva, both desirous of possessing the woman.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच अयमुत्सहते राजञ्छ्यिमाहर्तुमक्षवित्। द्यूतेन पाण्डुपुत्रेभ्यस्तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: Duryodhana said O king, this expert in dice (Shakuni) is ready to win the prosperity of the son of Pandu by means of dice. you ought to give him permission.

sa: अर्वावसुरुवाच बृहद्युम्नस्यधीमतः। ब्रह्मवध्यां चरिष्येऽहं त्वदर्थं नियतेन्द्रियः॥
en: Arvavasu said: Then perform the sacrifice of the intelligent Brihadyumna. On your behalf, I shall observe the vow prescribed in the case of killing a Brahmana by subduing my senses.

sa: विद्योतयन्निवाकाशमद्भुतोपमदर्शनः। धनानामीश्वरः श्रीमानर्जुनं द्रष्टुमागतः॥
en: The effulgent lord of wealth, most wonderfully beautiful, came there to see Arjuna illuminating the the sky with his effulgence.

sa: स्तैः सत्कृताः पाण्डुसुतैस्तथैव। नुपाविशन् देवगणा यथेन्द्रम्॥
en: They also paid due honours to the son of Pandu and were similarly honoured by him. () king, they sat round Yudhishthira as Indra is seated surrounded by the celestials.

sa: च्छीढरश्चैर्वाहिना स्यन्दनेन। ददर्शासीनंधर्मात्मानं विविक्ते सार्धं द्रौपद्या भातृभिर्ब्राह्मणैश्च॥
en: Thereupon going to the Kamyaka forest on a car drawn by swift horses, he saw Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) at a retired part (of the forest) sitting with Draupadi and surrounded by his brothers and the Brahmanas.

sa: तमेकाश्वेन मृगमनुसरन्तं मृगो दूरमपाहरत्॥
en: Pursuing a deer alone on a single horse he went away to a great distance (from his followers and retinue).

sa: पवित्रमृषिभिर्जुष्टं पुण्यं पावनमुत्तमम्। गङ्गायमुनयोर्वीर संगमं लोकविश्रुतम्॥
en: O hero, there is the sacred confluence of the Ganges and the Yamuna celebrated all over the world. Sacred and sin destroying it is ever adored by the holy Rishis.

sa: अनुबुध्यस्व राजेन्द्र वेत्थधर्मान् सनातनान्। क्रूरकर्माभिजातोऽसि यस्मादुद्विजते जनः॥
en: O king of kings, awake and understand the eternal virtues (of one's own order). You belong by birth to an order the acts of which are cruel and are the sources of pain to others.

sa: हरिताम्बुजसंच्छन्नां दिव्यां कनकपुष्कराम्। नानापक्षिजनाकीर्णां सूपतीर्थामकर्दमाम्॥
en: It was covered with green lilies, it was filled with golden lotuses, it swarmed with various birds, its banks were beautiful and free from mud.

sa: नदीजालसमाकीर्णान् नानापक्षियुतान् बहून्। नानाविधमृगैर्जुष्टान् वानरैश्चोपशोभितान्॥
en: Intersected by many rivulets and abounding in a large number of birds of various kinds and also in various sorts of beasts, beautified by elephants.

sa: अतिवादाद् वदाम्येष माधर्ममभिशङ्किथाः। धर्माभिशङ्की पुरुषस्तिर्यग्गतिपरायणः॥
en: From the evidence of the Vedas I say, “You should never doubt virtue; the person doubting virtue is destined to be born among the brutes."

sa: भवान् हि संवृतो वीरैर्धातृभिर्देवसम्मितैः। ब्रह्मकल्पैर्द्विजावयैश्च तस्मान्नार्हसि शोचितुम्॥
en: But you are encircled by your war-like brothers, who are equal to the celestials and also by the best of the twice-born Brahmanas, who arelike unto Brahma himself. Consequently, O king, you should not lament.

sa: पुत्रसंक्रामितश्रीस्तु बृहदश्वो महीपतिः। जगाम तपसे धीमांस्तपोवनममित्रहा॥
en: Having thus made over the royal dignity to his son, that ruler of earth, that chastiser of foes and the greatly intelligent Brihadashva retired into a forest to perform asceticism.

sa: चरमाणस्तु सोऽरण्ये तृणवीरुत्समावृते। कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासङ्गं ददर्श मुनिमन्तिके॥
en: While he was wandering in the forest covered with grass and creepers he saw near (him) a Muni wrapped up in an antelope's skin which served as an upper garment.

sa: को नाम जह्यादिह राज्यहेतोः। आर्यस्य मन्ये मरणाद् गरीयो यद्धर्ममुत्क्रम्य महीं प्रशासेत्॥
en: Having entered into such a pledge in the presence of all the pious and good men, who can now dare break it for the sake of a kingdom in this world? For in my opinion, to a respectable person death is not more serious than an act of transgression in order to gain a kingdom.

sa: पश्य नानाविधाकारैरग्निभिर्निचितां महीम्। मज्जन्तीमिव चाक्रान्तां ययातेर्यज्ञकर्मभिः॥
en: Behold how the ground is studded with places for sacrificial altars of all sorts. (Behold), the earth appears as if she is sinking under the preasure of Yayati's good works.

sa: सर्वे भवन्तस्त्वतिवीर्यसत्त्वा दिव्यौजसः संहननोपपन्नाः। लोकादमुष्मादवनि प्रपन्नाः स्वधीतविद्याः सुरकार्यहेतोः॥
en: You are highly powerful, vigorous, endued with celestials energy, well read and in order to serve the purpose of the gods have come down (from the heavens) and been born in this world for the extirpation (of the wicked people).

sa: अश्मसारमयं भाण्डं शुद्धदन्तत्सरूनसीन्। प्राग्ज्योतिषाधिपो दत्त्वा भगदत्तोऽव्रजत् तदा॥
en: Thereupon the king of Pragjyotisha Bhagadatta had to go away from the gate, giving away a number of swords with handles made of the purest ivory and well-adorned with diamonds and every kind of gems.

sa: गदापरिघनिस्त्रिंशशूलशक्तिपरश्वधाः। प्रगृहीता व्यरोचन्त यक्षराक्षसबाहुभिः॥
en: Then the maces, clubs, swords, spears, axes and the javelins carried in their arms by the Rakshasas, began to blaze.

sa: अश्वांस्तित्तिरिकल्माषांस्त्रिशतं शुकनासिकान्। उष्ट्रवामीस्त्रिंशतं च पुष्टाः पीलुशमीीङ्गुदैः॥
en: Also three hundred horses of the Tittiri and Kalmasha kinds, all possessing nose like the parrots; also three hundred camels, three hundred female asses, all fattened with olive and Pilusha.

sa: करेणुभिर्वारणैश्च प्रभिन्नकरटामुखैः। सरोऽवगाडैः क्रीडद्भिः समन्तादनुनादितम्॥
en: Male elephants with juice trickling down from their rent temples sported with the female elephants in the streams and filled the place with their roars.

sa: यां कपर्दिसुतामाहुद्देश्यादृश्येति देहिनः। तनुत्वात्सा सिनीवाली तृतीयाङ्गिरसः सुता॥
en: Sinivali was the third daughter of Angiras. Her body was of such slender make, that she was visible at one time and invisible at another and therefore she was likened to the daughter of Rudra.

sa: यो नूनममितायुः स्यादथवापि प्रमाणवित्। स कालं वै प्रतीक्षेत सर्वप्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान्॥
en: Only he whose life has no limit or he who knows with certainty what the period of his life (really) is or he who knows the future as if it were placed before his eyes can wait for the arrival of (a certain fixed) time.

sa: रूपौदार्यगुणोपेतां मण्डनार्हाममण्डिताम्। चन्द्रलेखामिव नवां व्योम्नि नीलाभ्रसंवृताम्॥
en: Endued with beauty and liberality and undecked in ornaments, although befitting thein, she looks like the crescent of the moon, newly appearing in heaven and enveloped with the dark clouds.

sa: भीममार्तस्वरं चक्रुर्भीमसेनभयार्दिताः। न्यस्तशस्त्रायुधाः क्लान्तः शोणिताक्ततनुच्छदाः॥
en: Began to utter loud wails of distress afflicted with the fear of Bhimasena. Casting off their weapons and wearied with their armour besmeared with blood,

sa: नापि यज्ञहनैः क्षुद्रैर्द्रष्टुं शक्यः कथंचन। पानपैर्गुरुतल्पैश्च मांसादैर्वा दुरात्मभिः॥
en: Those, who had put obstacles in the performance of sacrifices, who were mean, who were addicted to drinking, who had violated the preceptor's bed, who had taken or or meat and who were wicked-minded, were not capable of seeing it.

sa: तेषामेतमभिप्रायमाचचक्षे स्मयन्निव। धर्मादर्थाच्च कामाच्च कर्म साधुविगर्हितम्॥
en: They heard this proposal of theirs with laughter and ridicule for this (proposed) deed was against virtue, worldly benefit and desire as also against the principles of an honest man.

sa: एतच्चैवाहमर्हामि भूयश्च बलवृत्रहन्। त्रैलोकस्येश्वरो योऽहं परभृत्यत्वमागतः॥
en: O slayer of Bala and Vritra, this indeed do I deserve not; though lord of the three worlds I have been reduced to the state of a servant of another.

sa: निमित्तमरणाश्चान्ये चन्द्रसूर्यौ मही जलम्। वायुरग्निस्तथाऽऽकाशं ग्रहास्तारागणास्तथा॥
en: The others namely the moon, the sun, the earth, the water, the air, the fire and also the sky, the planets and the stars have their end in a cause.

sa: दस्थिच्छिन्दन् मर्मघाती सुघोरः। कर्णाच्छरो वाङ्मयस्तिग्मतेजाः प्रतिष्ठितो हृदये फाल्गुनस्य॥
en: The (speech) frightful and sharp as it was, went deep into the heart cutting the very bones. This arrow, of words, proceeding from Karna, possessed the power of fire and is buried in the heart of the son of Phulguna.

sa: यस्य ह्याभिनिवृत्तौ भवन्त्याप्यायिताः परे। तस्यार्थसिद्धिर्नियता नयेष्वर्थानुसारिणः॥
en: He, in the success of whose object others become interested, is sure to have his object crowned with success if he follows it according to the ordinary rules of prudence.

sa: श्वेताचलनिभाकारो दिव्याभरणभूषितः। सहस्रं धारयन् मूर्धा ज्वालाजिह्वो महाबलः॥
en: His body is of the size of the Shvetachala or white mountain and decked with diverse sorts of ornaments and holding a thousand heads with tongues like blazing fire. His strength and prowess are great.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वानुज्ञाप्य रामं शस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥ सम्पूज्यापाक्रमत् तेन रथेनादित्यवर्चसा।
en: Saying these words to Rama, the foremost of the wielders of weapons and taking leave of and paying his respects to him (matali) set out (for the celestials regions) on that car of sunlike splendour.

sa: यमदूतसमान् वेगे निपाते पावकोपमान्। रामेणाजौ विषहितान् वज्रनिष्पेषदारुणान्॥
en: Which in force are equal to the messengers of Yama and in causing havoc are like fire and which falling as they do with the heaviness of the thunderbolt could be borne only by Rama.

sa: अनार्यवृत्तमप्राज्ञमसूयकमधार्मिकम्। अनर्थाः क्षिप्रमायान्ति वाग्दुष्टं क्रोधनं तथा॥
en: Misery soon comes on him who leads a vicious life, who is wanting in wisdom, who is envious and sinful and who is wicked in speech and given to anger.

sa: दनिर्विष्टं पापकं धार्तराष्ट्रः। येषां युद्धं भीमसेनार्जुनाभ्यां तथाश्विभ्यां वासुदेवेन चैव॥
en: Then there are surely some acts done before (by them), the fruits of which have not been obtained by the son of Dhritarashtra of wicked souls for which battle is desired with Bhimasena and Arjuna and the same with the sons of Ashvin and Vamdeva.

sa: अनाम्नायमला वेदा ब्राह्मणस्याव्रतं मलम्॥ मलं पृथिव्या बाह्रीकाः पुरुषस्यानृतं मलम्। कौतूहलमला साध्वी विप्रवासमला: स्त्रियः॥
en: Not taking the name even, is the worst thing for the Vedas; not observing religious observances, the worst act of the Brahmanas; the Balhika's (a race of people, morally dead) are the worst inhabitants of the globe. Falsehood is the worst thing in a man. Curiosity is the worst thing in a chaste woman; and exile from home is the worst thing for all women.

sa: तथैवाक्षौहिणी गृह्य चेदीनामृषभो बली। धृष्टकेतुरुपागच्छत् पाण्डवानमितौजसः॥
en: And in the same way did Dhrishtaketu, who was powerful as the best of the Chedis come with an army, an Akshauhini in number, to the Pandavas, of immeasurable strength.

sa: अभिवादनशीलस्य नित्यं वृद्धोसेविनः। चत्वारि सम्प्रवर्धन्ते कीर्तिरायुर्यशो बलम्॥
en: He who has the habit of doing due honours to his elders and who always attends to the wishes of old persons, gets an increase of these four, viz., good name, life, fame and strength.

sa: अल्पेऽप्यपकृते मोहान शान्तिमधिगच्छति। तादृशैः संगतं नीचैर्नृशंसैरकृतात्मभिः॥
en: Even when slightly injured, they out of the want of self-control get no peace of mind. Companionship of one's self with such lowminded and heartless individuals should not be effected.

sa: दाशंसमानो द्वैरथे वासुदेवम्। तेनेवोन्मथितः कर्णिकारः॥
en: He, who out of impudence, engaged in a fight in chariots with Vasudeva, lies killed by Krishna like a Karnikara tree uprooted by the wind.

sa: वाचं तां वचनार्हस्य शिक्षाक्षरसमन्विताम्। अश्रौषमहमिष्टार्था पश्चाद्धृदयहारिणीम्॥
en: I then heard the words of that one who is fit to speak, which were rhythmical and calculated to lead to the good of all, though heart-rending in the end.

sa: मूढचाकृतबुद्धिश्च इन्द्रियाणामनीश्वरः । कामानुसारी कृत्येषु सर्वेष्वकृतनिश्चयः॥
en: He is a fool with his understanding uncultivated, the slave of his senses, following the lead of his desires and hesitates to do a thing which ought to be done.

sa: अकृताह्निकमेवैनं जिघांसुर्जितकाशिनम्। शरैर्जघान संक्रुद्धः कृतसंज्ञोऽथ लक्ष्मणः।१७।।
en: And desirous of slaying Indrajita, who was elated with success and who had not yet completed his daily sacrifice, Lakshmana, at a hint (from Vibhishana) assailed him wrathfully with arrows.

sa: मत्या परीक्ष्य मेधावी बुद्ध्या सम्पाद्य चासकृत्। श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वाथ विज्ञाय प्राझैमैत्री समाचरेत्॥
en: The holy books are lost on those who have no souls of their own (have no control over them); and an offering of clarified butter is lost when poured on what is not fire (i.e. when the fire has been extinguished and ashes only remain). Having examined by his intelligence and searched by his understanding.

sa: पितामह उवाच बहुवर्षसहस्रान्तं प्रजापालनवर्धितम्। अनेकक्रतुदानौधैर्यत् त्वयोपार्जितं फलम्॥
en: The grandsire said The merit, earned by you by protecting your subjects and increasing the human stock for a great many thousands of years and the performance of many sacrificial rites and making many gifts,

sa: अविध्यदिन्द्रजित् तीक्ष्णैः सौमित्रिं मर्मभेदिभिः। सौमित्रिश्चानलस्पर्शेरविध्यद् रावणि शरैः॥
en: Then Indrajita pierced the son of Sumitra by sharpened arrows capable of penetrating into the vital parts. And the son of Sumitra too wounded the son of Ravana with arrows having the touch of fire.

sa: अन्यत्र ब्राह्मणात् तात सर्वपापेष्ववस्थितात्। गुरुर्हि सर्ववर्णानां ब्राह्मणः प्रसृताग्रभुक्॥
en: An exception should be made, O Sire, in the case of a Brahmana, though he be addicted to all sorts of vices; for a Brahmana is the preceptor of all the other classes and he is allowed precedence in everything.

sa: बहुवर्षसहस्रान्तं प्रजापालनवर्धितम्। अनेकक्रतुदानौधैरर्जितं मे महत् फलम्॥
en: Great was the merit earned by me by protecting my subjects and increasing the human stock for a great many thousands of years and by many sacrificial rites and pieties.

sa: सचिवाश्चास्य चत्वारः शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनाः। श्वेतपर्वतमारूढा मोक्ष्यन्तेऽस्मान्महाभयात्॥
en: And I saw his four counsellors adorned with white garlands and unguents on the mountain Shveta. These only will be saved from this terrible calamity.

sa: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। पुत्रार्थमसुरेन्द्रेण गीतं चैव सुधन्वना॥
en: In this connection people cite the old story that is related about what passed between Sudhanvan and the chief of the Asuras for the sake of his (the latter's) son.

sa: प्रव्रजन्तोऽनुधावन्तीं कृपणां पुत्रगृद्धिनीम्। रुदतीमुपहायैनामगच्छाम वयं वनम्॥
en: When we were about to go into exile, she followed us in distress out of fondness for her children crying aloud; but we went to the forest leaving her behind.

sa: मृगरूपधेरणाथ रक्षसा सोऽपकर्षणम्। भ्रातुरागमनं चैव चिन्तयन् पर्यतप्यत॥
en: And he was greatly afflicted with grief thinking of his being allured to a great distance by the Rakshasa assuming the form of a deer and of the arrival of his brother (leaving Sita alone).

sa: शुश्रू शरीरसत्कारैः सर्वैराच्छादनादिभिः। श्वशुरं देवसत्कारैर्वाचः संयमनेन च॥
en: By ministering to her physical comforts and by (covering her with) all sorts of robes, she delighted her mother-in-law. And she pleased her father-in-law by worshipping him as a god and by controlling her words.

sa: शरचापप्लवां घोरां केशशैवलशाद्वलाम्। तनुत्रोष्णीषसम्बाधाः नागकूर्ममहाद्विपाम्॥
en: Having coats of mail and turbans floating on the surface, the elephants standing for islands. The marrow, fat and blood constituted the greatly terrific currents.

sa: सांख्यशूराश्च बहवो योगशूरास्तथापरे। अरण्ये गृहवासे च त्यागे शूरास्तथापरे॥
en: There are many persons who may be called the heroes of the Shankhya faith, there are many others that are called heroes of Yoga. There are others who are considered as heroes in the forest-life, of domesticity, and of renunciation.

sa: ततो नारायणं तेजो व्रतचर्येन्धनोत्थितम्। वक्त्रानिःसृत्य कृष्णस्य वह्निरद्भुतकर्मणः॥
en: At that time the energy, in the form of fire, of Narayana, rising from the fuel that consisted of the rigid observance of his vow, came out of the mouth of Krishna of wonderful deeds.

sa: तथैव स गिरिभूर्यः प्रपुष्पितलताद्रुमः। सपक्षिगणसंघुष्टः सश्वापदसरीसृपः॥
en: That mountain thereupon once becaine bedecked with flowering trees and creepers, and once more echoed with the notes and cries of birds and deer and animals of prey and reptiles.

sa: कुबेरमिव रक्षांसि शतक्रतुमिवामराः। ज्ञातयस्त्वानुजीवन्तु सुहृदश्च परंतप॥
en: Let all your kinsmen and all your friends and well-wishers, O scorcher of enemies, seek refuge with you as the Rakshasas seek Kubera or the gods seek Indra as theirs.

sa: वनं प्रविशतानेन वायुभक्षेण धीमता। अग्नयः कारयिन्वेष्टिमुत्सृष्टा इति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that when the old king gifted with great intelligence and living on air alone entered the forest (after his return from Gangadvara), he caused his sacrificial fires to be duly ignited. Having performed is sacred rites there with, be abandoned them all.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य भाग्यक्षय उपस्थिते। सर्वमेतदवज्ञाय कृतवानिदमीदृशम्॥
en: Sometime after, the good fortune of Nahusha decreased, and as the outcome of it, he neglected all these observances and began to act in defiance of all control in the manner I have already described.

sa: दाता दशानुगृह्णाति दश हन्ति तथा क्षिपन्। पूर्वदत्तां हरन् भूमिं नरकायोपगच्छति॥
en: The giver of earth, it has been already said, rescues ten generations of both his paternal and maternal families. Likewise, by taking away earth that was given away, one sinks himself into hell and casts ten generations of both one's paternal and maternal lines into the same place of misery.

sa: स पञ्चधा पञ्चजनोपपन्न संचोदयन् विश्वमिदं सिसृक्षुः। ततश्चकारावनिमारुतौ च खं ज्योतिरम्भश्च तथैव पार्थ॥
en: For crcating this universe which consists of the five primal elements, he begins this work, and causcs it to go on in the fivefold form of animate existence containing celestial and Asuras and human beings and beasts and birds. He it is who then creates the Earth and the Wind, the Sky, Light, and also Water, O son of Pritha.

sa: भूमिदानस्य पुण्यानि फलं स्वर्गः पुरंदर। हिरण्यपुष्पाश्चौषध्य: कुशकाञ्चनशाद्वलाः॥
en: The rewards of the gifts of earth consist of residence in the celestial region, O Purandara, and gold, and flowers, and plants and herbs of medicinal virtue, and Kusha and mineral wealth and verdant grass.

sa: एतदाङ्गिरसाच्छ्रुत्वा वासवो वसुधामिमाम्। वसुरत्नसमाकीर्णां ददावाङ्गिरसे तदा॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words from the son of Angiras, Vasava made a gift to him of the whole Earth with all her jewels and gems and all her riches.

sa: किरीटी वज्रधृग् धन्वी मुकुटी बद्धकुण्डलः॥ भवत्यथ मुहूर्तेन चण्डालसमदर्शनः।
en: Sometimes he wears a diadem and holds the thunderbolt. Sometimes, armed with the thunder bolt and wearing a crown on his head, he adorns himself with earrings. In a moment he changes himself into the shape and aspect of Chandala.

sa: ततो गान्धारराजेन युद्धमासीत् किरीटिनः। घोरं शकुनिपुत्रेण पूर्ववैरानुसारिणा॥
en: Then took place a dreadful battle between the diadem-decked hero and the king of the Gandharas, viz., the son of Shakuni, who had a bitter remembrance of the grudge his father bore to the Pandavas.

sa: विद्यास्नाता व्रतस्नाता ये व्यपाश्रित्य जीविनः। गूढस्वाध्यायतपसो ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः॥
en: There are persons bathed in learning and bathed in vows. Without depending upon anybody they get their means of living. These Brahmanas of rigid vows are given to Vedic study and penances without proclaiming their practices to any one. men

sa: इत्युक्तस्त्वर्जुनस्तूष्णीमभूद् वायुस्तमब्रवीत्। शृणु मे हैहयश्रेष्ठ कर्मात्रेः सुमहात्मनः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed, Arjuna remained silent. The god of wind once more addressed him, saying, Hear me, O foremost one of the Haihayas, as I describe to you the achicvement of the great Atri.

sa: केशास्थिकलिले भीमे कपालघटसंकुले। गृध्रगोमायुबहुले चिताग्निशतसंकुले॥
en: The crematorium is full of the hair and bones (of the dead), abounds with vultures and jackals, and is covered with hundreds of funeral pyres.

sa: एते विनायकाः श्रेष्ठा दक्षाः शान्ता जितेन्द्रियाः॥५७ नराणामशुभं सर्वे व्यपोहन्ति प्रकीर्तिताः।
en: These are considered as the foremost of all, as the leaders of the universe, as highly clever in the performance of all things, as gifted with forgiveness, as complete masters of the senses. Indeed, it has been said that they remove all the evils to which human beings are subject.

sa: पौष्टिका रूपदाश्चैव तथा पापविनाशनाः। तस्मात् सर्वप्रदानेभ्यस्तिलदानं विशिष्यते॥
en: Sesame seeds confer both prosperity and personal beauty cleanse the giver of all his sins. It is for this reason that the gift of sesame seeds is superior to the gift of every other article.

sa: इमं स्तवमधीयानः श्रद्धाभक्तिसमन्वितः। युज्येतात्मसुखक्षान्तिश्रीधृतिस्मृतिकीर्तिभिः॥
en: That man who with devotion and faith recites this hymn succeeds in acquiring beatitude, forgiveness, prosperity, intelligence, memory, and fame.

sa: शम्याक्षेपैरयजं यच्च देवान् साद्यस्कानामयुतैश्चापि यत्तत्। त्रयोदशद्वादशाहैश्च देव सपौण्डरीकान्न च तेषां फलेन॥
en: Throwing the Shami, I worshipped the gods in numberless such sacrifices as are completed in course of single day, and such others as take twelve days for completing, and others still as can be completed in thirteen days, besides many Pundarikas. I have not acquired this region through the merits of any of those sacrifices.

sa: कौशिकी तु समासाद्य वायुभक्षस्त्वलोलुपः। एकविंशतिरात्रेण स्वर्गमारोहते नरः॥
en: Going to the tirtha Kaushiki and living there with a pure heart and abstaining from all food and drink for three days, one acquires the power of living in the happy region of the Gandharvas.

sa: दीना दीनं स्थितं पार्थमब्रवीच्चाप्यधोमुखम्॥ स्वसारं समवेक्षस्व स्वस्त्रीयात्मजमेव च।
en: Arjuna stood before her great cheerlessness of heart. His face was turned towards the Earth. The cheerless sister then said to her brother, who was equally cheerless, these words : See your sister. See the child of your sister's son.

sa: अहिंसानिरतो नित्यं जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। षड्भिरेव स वषैस्तु सिध्यते नात्र संशयः॥ तप्तकाञ्चनवर्णं च विमानं लभते नरः। देवस्त्रीणामधीवसे नृत्यगीतनिनादिते॥ प्राजापत्ये वसेत् पद्मं वर्षाणामग्निसंनिभे।
en: That man who takes one meal in the forenoon and one at night, without taking any food or drink during the interval and who observes this regulation for a period of six years successively abstaining all the while from injuring any creature and regularly pouring libations on his sacred fire every day, attains, forsooth, to success. Such a man acquires hereafter a car of the colour of heated gold, and acquires a residence, for millions of years, in the region of Prajapati, in the company of celestial ladies, that ever echoes with the sound of music and dance, and shines with the effulgence of fire.

sa: गन्धर्वैरुपगीयन्तः स्तूयमानाच वन्दिभिः। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरा वृताश्चाप्सरसां गणैः॥
en: Gandharvas sang their praises, and bards waited on them, chanting then deeds, Robed with celestial raiment's and wearing celestial garlands, each of them was waited upon by bands of Apsaras.

sa: भीष्म उवाच क्रिया भवति केषांचिदुपांशुव्रतमुत्तमम्। यो यो याचेत यत् किञ्चित् सर्वं दद्याम इत्यपि॥
en: Bhishma said All these are equal. The fitness of some consists in their soliciting alms for celebrating sacrifices or for paying the preceptor's fee or for maintaining their wives and children. The fitness of some, for receiving gifts, consists in their following the vow of wandering over the Earth, never soliciting anything but receiving when given. We should also give to one what one seeks.

sa: सदा द्वादशमासान् वै सोमयज्ञफलं लभेत्। सोमकन्यानिवासेषु सोऽध्यावसति नित्यशः॥
en: Proceeding to the celestial region, he lives in the company of Soma's daughters. His body fragrant with unguents whose perfumes are as sweet as those of Soma himself, he acquires the power of going immediately to any place he likes.

sa: सर्वातिथ्यं त्रिवर्गस्य यथाशक्ति निशानिशम्। शूद्रधर्मः समाख्यातस्त्रिवर्गपरिचारणम्॥
en: Hospitality towards all, and the pursuit of the threefold objects are the duties of the householder. The duties of the Shudra consist in the pursuit of the three fold objects.

sa: सौम्यगन्धानुलिप्तश्च कामकारगतिर्भवेत्। सुदर्शनाभिर्नारीभिर्मधुराभिस्तथैव च॥
en: Seated on his car he is waited upon by beautiful damsels of agreeable manners, and commands all articles of enjoyment.

sa: वृक्षमूलपरो नित्यं शून्यागारनिवेशनः। नदीपुलिनशायी च नदीतीररतिश्च यः॥
en: He seeks for no other shelter than the foot of a tree, He lives in vacant houses of men. He sleeps on the banks of rivers. He takes a pleasure in living by such banks.

sa: न सम्बुबुधिरे चैव देवास्तं भुवनेश्वरम्। सप्रजापतयः सर्वे तस्मिन् मुमुहुरीश्वरे॥
en: The celestials all became stupefied, and they could not understand that child was the Master of the universe. Indeed, all of them, along with the very Regents of the world, found their intellects stupefied about that child who was none else than the Supreme Being.

sa: दुःखशोकमयैोरैः सङ्गस्नेहसमुद्भवैः। न विचाल्यति युक्तात्मानिःस्पृहः शान्तमानसः॥
en: Devoid of desire and gifted with a tranquil mind, the person in Yoga is never affected by pain and sorrow and fear and the dreadful effects of attachment and affection.

sa: ततो ददर्श नृपतिः प्रासादं सर्वकाञ्चनम्। मणिस्तम्भसहस्राढ्यं गन्धर्वनगरोपमम्॥
en: Arrived there, the king saw a palatial inansion made entirely of gold. Having a thousand columns each of which was made of gems and precious stones, it looked like a mansion belonging to the Gandharvas.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच वसिष्ठोऽस्म वरिष्ठोऽस्मि वसे वासगृहेष्वपि। वसिष्ठत्वाच्च वासाच्च वसिष्ठ इति विद्धि माम्।।८४।
en: Vasishtha said I am gifted with Yoga powers, I live again, as a householder, and am considered as the foremost of all persons that lead such a mode of life. On account of my being gifted with (such) powers, of my having as a householder, and of my being considered, as the foremost of all householders, I am called Vasishtha.

sa: चीरवल्कलसंवीतैर्मृगचर्मनिवासिभिः। कार्या यात्रा यथाकालं यथाधर्मे यथाविधि।॥
en: Some of them clothe themselves with rage and barks of trees or deer skins. Thus do they pass their lives for the time allotted to them, according to the ordinances.

sa: भिक्षवे बहुपुत्राय श्रोत्रियायाहिताग्नये। दत्त्वां दशगवां दाता लोकानाप्नोत्यनुत्तमान्॥
en: A person, by making a gift of ten kine to a Brahmana learned in the Vedas, poor in earthly riches, possessed of many children, and owning a domestic fire, attains numerous regions of great happiness.

sa: कदाचिद् विचरन्तस्ते वृक्षरविरलैर्वृताम्। शुचिवारिप्रसन्नोदां ददृशुः पद्मिनी शुभाम्॥
en: One day, as they were travelling, they saw a beautiful lake filled with lotuses. Its banks were covered with trees which stood thickly ncar one another. The waters of the lake were pure and transparent.

sa: प्राश्वा भवति राजेन्द्र ततः क्रव्यात्ततः खरः। ततः प्रेतः परिक्लिष्टः पश्चाज्जायति ब्राह्मणः॥
en: Such a person, o king, has in the first instance to become a dog. He has then to become a beast of prey, and then an ass. Living his assinine form he has to wander for sometime in great, misery as a spirit. After the expiration of that time, he is born as a Brahmana.

sa: मदङ्गेभ्यः प्रसूतानि मदाश्रयकृतानि च। ममैव तान्यपत्यानि वरुणो दवद्यात्मकः॥
en: "Agni said, These children have originated from my limbs. They have all depended upon me as the cause of their being. They should, therefore, be considered as my children. Mahadeva in the form of Varuna has erred in this matter.

sa: सुवर्णं दक्षिणामाहुर्गोप्रदाने महाद्युते! सुवर्णं परमित्युक्तं दक्षिणार्थमसंशयम्॥
en: Gold has been said to form the present, O you of great splendour, in gifts of kine. Indeed, gold has been said to be the best present in all sacrifices.

sa: मेकला द्राविडा लाटाः पौण्ड्राः कान्वशिरास्तथा। शौण्डिका दरदा दार्वाश्चौराः शबरबर्बराः॥
en: The Mekalas, the Dravidas, the Lathas, the Paundras, the Knowashiras, the Shaundikas, the Daradas, the Darvas, Darvas, the Chauras, Shavaras, the Varvaras, the Kiratas, the Yavanas and numerous other tribes of Kshatriyas, have degenerated into the status of Shudras through the anger of the Brahmanas.

sa: तिलालाभे तु यो दद्याज्जलधेनुं यतव्रतः। स कामप्रवहां शीतां नदीमेतामुपाश्नुते॥
en: If a cow made of sesame seeds, is not available, one makes a gift of a cow made of water, he succeeds in coming to these happy regions and enjoying this river of cool and transparent water, that can grant the fruition of every desire.

sa: अग्निकार्याणि समिधः कुशाः सुमनसस्तथा। बलयश्चान्नलाजाभिषूपनं दीपकर्म च॥ सर्वं तस्य गृहे राज्ञः प्रावर्तत महात्मनः। जपयज्ञान्मनोयज्ञास्त्रिदिवेऽपि चकार सः॥
en: The various rites with respect to the sacrificial fire, the collection of sacred fuel and of Kusha grass, as also of flowers, and the presentation of Bali consisting of food adorned with fried paddy, and the offer of incense and of light, all there, O monarch, occurred daily in the house of that great king while he lived in the celestial region. Indeed, though living in the celestial region. he celebrated the sacrifice of recitation and the sacrifice of meditation.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः श्रुतसम्पन्ना ये त्रिवर्गमनुष्ठिताः। अलोलुपाः पुण्यशीलास्तान् नमस्यामि केशव॥
en: I bow to them, O Keshava, who are conversant with Brahma, who are gifted with knowledge of the Vedas, who are attentive to the threefold objects of life, who are free from cupidity, and who are righteous in their behaviour.

sa: आपनश्चापदो मुच्येद् बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात्। मुच्येत्तथाऽऽतुरो रोगाद् दुःखान्मुच्येत दुःखितः।।७४
en: When afflicted with calanity, he immediately gets over it. When obstructed with obstacles, he succeeds in freeing himself from them with the utmost case. When suffering from a disease, he becomes quickly cured, and afflicted with sorrow he becomes liberated from it with greatest ease.

sa: अपापमशठं वृत्तमजिह्यं नित्यमाचरेत्। जोषयेत सदा भोज्यं ग्रासमागतमस्पृहः॥
en: He should always practise a sinless mode of conduct, which is not deceptive or crooked. Shorn of attachments he should always make one who comes as a guest eat (at least) a morsel of food.

sa: न ह्यकामेन संवासं मनुरेवं प्रशंसति। अयशस्यमधर्म्यं च यन्मृषा धर्मकोपनम्॥
en: Manu does not speak highly of the practice of a girl living with a person whom she does not like. Living as wife with a person whom she does not like, produces disgrace and sin. No one commits sin in any of the following cases.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कन्यायां प्राप्तशुल्कायां ज्यायांश्चेदाव्रजेद् वरः। धर्मकामार्थसम्पन्नो वाच्यमत्रानृतं न वा॥
en: Yudhishthira said When after the receipt of dower for a girl, the girl's father more eligible sees a bridegroom,-one, who is endued with the threefold objects, does the girl's father commit sin by rejecting the person from whom dower had been received in favour of him who is more eligible?

sa: उमोवाच इमे मनुष्या दृश्यन्ते उहापोहविशारदाः। ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नाः प्रज्ञावन्तोऽर्थकोविदाः॥
en: Uma said In the world some men are inasters of inferences and the premises leading to them. Indeed, they are masters of science and knowledge, have large progeny, and are gifted with learning and wisdom.

sa: सर्वान्नो द्विषतस्तात ब्राह्मणा जातमन्यवः। गीर्भिर्दारुणयुक्ताभिरभिध्यासुरपूजिताः॥
en: Disregarded by our enemies, let them be engaged with these, and let thein wish evil to those detractors of theirs, imprecating them with severe curses.

sa: अग्न्यभावे च कुरुते वह्निस्थानेषु काञ्चनम्। जामदग्न्य प्रमाणज्ञो वेदश्रुतिनिदर्शनात्॥
en: When fire is not to be had, gold is used as a substitute. Guided by the marks of the auditions of the Veda, one who is conversant with authorities and who knows the identity of gold with fire, acts thus.

sa: चतुर्णामेव वर्णानां धर्मो नान्यस्य विद्यते। वर्णानां धर्महीनेषु संख्या नास्तीह कस्यचित्॥
en: The duties have been laid down in the scriptures of only the four principal castes. About others, the scriptures are entirely silent. Among all the castes, the members of those castes that have no duties assigned to them by the scriptures, need entertain no fears as to what they do.

sa: चारयेयाश्च सततं चारैरविदितः परैः। परीक्षितैर्बहुविधैः स्वराष्ट्रप्रतिवासिभिः॥
en: You should always gather information through spies in various disguises, whose faithfulness have been tested, who are natives of your kingdom, and who should not be known to your enemies.

sa: पाण्डुकम्बलवर्णाभां सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां साध्यानां लोकमाप्नुते॥
en: By giving away a cow of the hue of a white blanket, with a calf and a vessel of white brass, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires the region of the Saddhyas.

sa: एतत् कृत्यतमं राज्ञो नित्यमेवोपलक्षयेत्। यथाऽऽत्मानं यथा पुत्रांस्तथैतान् प्रतिपालयेत्॥
en: This is the foremost of all acts laid down for the king. Indeed, the king should always keep his eyes fixed on this. He should protect and cherish these, even as he protects his own self or his own children.

sa: हिरण्यवर्णां पिंगाक्षीं सवत्सां कांस्यदोहनाम्। प्रदाय वस्त्रसंवीतां कौबेरं लोकमश्नुते॥
en: By giving away a goldhued cow, having eyes of a tawny colour, with a calf and a vessel of white brass for making her, and covered with a piece of cloth, one enjoys the happiness of the region of Kubera.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा तु वसुस्तेषामविचार्य बलाबलम्। यथोपनीतैर्यष्टव्यमिति प्रोवाच पार्थिवः॥
en: Hearing the question, king Vasu, without at all judging the merits of the arguments advanced on both sides, at once answered, saying, 'Sacrifices may be performed with any of the two kinds of objects ready.'

sa: नान्तमेषां प्रपश्यामि न दिशश्चाप्यपावृताः। कुपिताः समुदीक्षन्ते दावेष्वग्निशिखा इव ॥
en: I do not see anything that can destroy them. Their power seems to be uncontrolled, being capable of reaching to the last end of the universe. When angry, their looks fall upon men and things like a burning flame of fire upon a forest. are

sa: शका यवनकाम्बोजास्तास्ताः क्षत्रियजातयः। वृषलत्वं परिगता ब्राह्मणानामदर्शनात्॥
en: It is on account of the absence of Brahmanas from among them that the Shakas, the Yavanas, the Kamvojas and other Kshatriya tribes have become fallen and degraded into Shudras.

sa: नास्ति यज्ञक्रिया काचित्र श्राद्धं नोपवासकम्। धर्मः स्वभर्तृशुश्रूषा तया स्वर्ग जयन्त्युत॥
en: Women have no sacrifices ordained for them. There are no Shraddhas which they are called upon to perform. They are not required to observe any fasts. To serve their husbands wish respect and willing obedience from their only duty. Through the satisfaction of that duty they succeed in conquering Heaven.

sa: गोमत्या विद्यया धेनुं तिलानामभिमन्त्र्य यः। सर्वरत्नमयीं दद्यान्न स शोचेत् कृताकृते॥
en: That man who inspires a cow's form made of sesame seeds by uttering the Vedic Mantras named Gomati, and then adorns that form with every sort of gems and makes a gift of it, has never to suffer any grief on account of all his deeds of omission and commission.

sa: ऋषभाः शास्त्रपठितास्तथा जलचराश्च ये। सर्वोस्तानभ्ययुजस्ते तत्राग्निचयकर्मणि॥
en: Bulls, possessed of such marks as are mentioned in the scriptures, and aquatic animals were properly tied to the stakes after the rites of the sacrificial fire had been performed.

sa: यत् तद्धयशिरः पार्थ समुदेति वरप्रदम्॥ सोऽहमेवोत्तरे भागे क्रमाक्षरविभागवित्।
en: O Partha, He who rises and who gives various gods, is none else then myself. I am He who is the repository of the science of syllables and pronunciation that is treated of in the supplemental parts of the Vedas.

sa: नमः कपालहस्ताय चितिभस्मप्रियाय च। विभीषणाय भीष्माय भीमव्रतधराय च॥
en: Salutations to you who are armed with bones and who are fond of the ashes of funeral pyres. Salutation to you who are dreadful, who are horrible to look at, and who are an observer of dreadful, vows and practises.

sa: उपपन्नं महाशस्त्रैः सर्वोपकरणान्वितम्। तत्कुलीनेन वीरेण हयशास्त्रविदाणे॥
en: It was also furnished with great weapons and all other necessary things and guided by a charioteer of good birth well versed in the art of the management of horses,

sa: ज्ञातिश्रेष्ठ्यमवाप्नोति प्रयोगकुशलो नरः॥ अद्भिःप्राणान् समालभ्य नाभिं पाणितले तथा।
en: The man who knows how to observe all these ordinances carefully carefully succeeds in acquiring the foremost place among kinsmen. One should, after finishing his meals, wash his nose and eyes and ears and navel and both hands with water.

sa: नमो वृषाय वृष्याय गोवृषाय वृषाय च। कटंकटाय दण्डाय नमः पचपचाय च॥
en: Salutations to you who make rain, who help the cause of virtue, who are identifiable with the form of Nandi, and who Righteousness's self! Salutations to you who are ever moving like wind and the other forces, who are the controller of all things, and who are always engaged in coO king all creatures. are

sa: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्। पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्॥
en: I behold you without beginning, middle and end. I behold you possessing infinite prowess and innumerable arms, having the sun and the moon as your two eyes, and the blazing fire as your mouth; I behold you heating the universe with your own great energy.

sa: तथा नोद्धृतसाराणि प्रेक्ष्यते नाप्रदाय च॥ न संनिकृष्टे मेधावी नाशुचेर्न च सत्सु च।
en: One should never eat any food or drink any liquid whose essence has been taken off. Nor should one eat anything without giving a part thereof to persons who wistfully gaze at the food that one happens to take. The intelligent man should never sit near an impure person. Nor should one sit near persons who are foremost in virtue.

sa: तस्य शिष्यो बभूवाग्यो राजोपरिचरो वसुः। अधीतवांस्तदा शास्त्रं सम्यक् चित्रशिखण्डिजम्॥
en: King Uparichara, otherwise called Vasu, became a disciple of Brihaspati and soon became the greatest of his disciples. Admitted as such, he began of study from his preceptor that science which was composed by the seven Rishis who were known by the name of Chitrashikhandins.

sa: तैर्भिन्नवर्माभरणाश्छिन्नभिन्नशरासनाः। निपेतुः शोणितादिग्धा धरण्यां रजनीचराः॥
en: And, their armour and ornaments severed, and their bows broken in shivers, those rangers of the night fell down on the earth, bathed in blood.

sa: येनैवमागता द्वैधं तव बुद्धिर्महामते। सोऽपि धर्मो मम द्वेष्यो यत्प्रसङ्गाद् विमुह्यसि॥
en: Even that so called virtue do I loathe, which has, O high-souled one, fascinated you, and made your mind run from one extreme to another. *Formerly the mind was for accepting the kingdom, and now for going to the forest as an exile. These are the two extremes here meant.

sa: नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय हिरण्यकवचाय च। हिरण्यकृतचूडाय हिरण्यपतये नमः॥
en: Salutations to you who have gold in your stomach. To you who are accoutered in golden mail, to you who are gold-created, to you who are the lord of all the gold in the world.

sa: रुक्मपुत्रैः सुनिशितैर्गापत्रैरजिह्मगैः॥ उचकर्त शिरांस्युग्रो यवनानां भुजानपि।
en: The fierce Satyaki then began to lop off the heads and arms of the Yavanas, with sharp arrows cquipt with golden wings or wings made of vultering feathers, all-flying straight.

sa: गतासवस्तथैवान्ये प्रगृहीतशरासनाः। हतसारथयस्तत्र व्यकृष्यन्त तुरंगमैः॥
en: Others, holding their bows in their hands, even when deprived of life and their charioteers being slain, were carried (hither and thither) by the horses.

sa: सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चात्र वेगदर्शी च वानरः। मृत्युर्वानररूपेण नूनं सृष्टः स्वयंभुवा॥
en: And Sumukha, Durmukha and the monkey, vegadarcin (resembling) Death himself, were for certain begot by the Self-create in the shape of a monkey.* *Another meaning is, “The monkey, Vegadarsi who is death himself in the shape of a monkey." But I give the acceptable sense.

sa: न चैतन्नैष्ठिकं कर्म त्रयाणां भूरिदक्षिण। चतुर्णां राजशार्दूल प्राहुराश्रमवासिनाम्॥
en: A life of mendicancy is not compulsory for the three orders (viz., Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras), O giver of profuse presents. This mode of life, is open to all the four castes because they can adopt it if they choose.

sa: अरजापि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः। प्रतीक्षते सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसंनिभम्॥
en: Arajă cried aloud in forest at no distance from the hermitage and waited for here sire who had been away on visiting the celestials. a blameless person, if you do pray, my father may make me over to your hands.

sa: कपर्दी जटिला मुण्डः श्मशान गृहसेवकः॥ उग्रव्रतचरो रुद्रो योगी परमदारुणः।
en: Rudra is otherwise called Kaparddin. He has matted locks on his head, some times shows a bald head. He loves to live in the midst of crematoriums which form his home. He practises the austerest vows. He is a Yogin of mighty power and energy.

sa: तथैव चान्यैरपि शास्त्रवेदिभिः स्वलंकृतैः शास्त्रविधानदृष्टिभिः। सुशिक्षितैर्भाष्यकथाविशारदैः परेषु कृत्यामुपधारयेच्च॥
en: At the same time, in their own cities, they should, through other persons well-read in scriptures, endued with every accomplishment, acquainted with the injunctions of the sacred books; and possessed of learning, cause incantations, and foe-destroying rites to be performed.

sa: अल्पाबाधास्तथा केचिन्महाबाधास्तथापरे। दृश्यन्ते पुरुषा देव तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Some have to suffer little pain, while others there are that are loaded with heavy calamities. Such diverse sights are seen of men. O illustrious one, you should tell me the reason of all this!

sa: एवं स राजा कौरव्य चक्रे दानमहाक्रतुम्। नटनर्तकलास्याढ्यां बह्वन्नरसदक्षिणम्॥
en: Thus did that king of Kuru's race celebrate his Gift-Sacrifice. Actors and mimes continually danced and sang on the occasion and contributed to the pleasure of all the guests. Food and drink of various tastes were given away in profusion.

sa: गोधानिमीलिताः केचिन्मृदुप्रकृतयस्तथा। तरङ्गगतिनि?षास्ते नरा: पारयिष्णवः॥
en: Some who have eyes closed like those of iguana, a mild disposition and speed and voice like the horse's are capable to fight all enemies,

sa: दीप्यमानं स्ववपुषा दिव्यैरस्त्रैरुपस्थितम्। चक्रप्रभृतिभिर्घारैर्दिव्यैः पुरुषविग्रहैः॥
en: Shining in that forin of his, he was adorned with celestial weapon, such as the dreadful and discus and others in their respective embodied form.

sa: किमुतैतत् समासाद्य धीरसंयुगगोष्पदम्। आयुष्मन् कतरेण त्वां प्रापयामि धनंजयम्॥
en: O you of great courage, why shall I then experience any fear in this battle, which is like the vestige of a cow's hoof. O long-lived one, by which track shall I carry you to the spot where Dhananjaya is?

sa: श्वेतपिङ्गलनेत्राय कृष्णरक्तेक्षणाय च। प्राणभग्नाय दण्डाय स्फोटनाय कृशाय च॥
en: Salutations to you who have eyes both white and tawny, as also dark and red. Salutations to you who have conquered your vital airs, who are of the form of weapons, who rivet all things, and who are greatly lean.

sa: अग्निः कपोतरूपेण तमभ्यधावदामिषार्थमिन्द्रः श्येनरूपेणः॥
en: Agni, assuming the form of a region flew away from Indra who pursued him in the form of a hawk.

sa: ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिमित्राणि पूजनीयानि सर्वशः॥ यष्टव्यं च यथाशक्ति यज्ञैर्विविधदक्षिणैः।
en: Kinsmen and relatives by marriage and friends should all be treated with respect. One should, to the best of his power, worship the celestials in sacrifices, giving away various kinds of articles as sacrificial presents.

sa: प्रमत्तसंनादितबर्हिणानि सशक्रगोपाकुलशाद्वलानि। चरन्ति नीपार्जुनवासितानि गजाः सुरम्याणि वनान्तराणि॥
en: The elephants are ranging in this charming forest-land, carrying the fragrance of Neepas and Arjunas, having its green swards filled with Indragopas* and with delighted, peacocks dancing all around. *An insect (Coccinella of various kinds).

sa: उन्मादन शतावर्त गङ्गातोयामूर्धज। चन्द्रावर्त युगावर्त मेघावर्त नमोऽस्तु ते॥
en: Salutations to you who are the excitement of Fever and who have matted locks drenched with the waters of the Ganges having hundreds of eddies. Salutations to you who again and again revolve the Moon, the Yugas, and the clouds.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव राजेन्द्र पाण्डवानां निवेशनम्। अप्रेक्षणीयमभवदार्तस्वनविनादितम्॥
en: Resounding with the voice of lamentation the palace of the Pandavas, O king, was soon converted into a house of sorrow where nobody could remain.

sa: लम्बकर्णललाटां च लम्बोदरपयोधराम्। लम्बोष्ठी चिबुकोष्ठी च लम्बास्यां लम्बजानुकाम्॥
en: Some had long ears some had a long forehead, some had a long belly, some had long breasts; some had long lips; some had their lips and chins stuck together, some had a long countenance and some had long knees.

sa: होत्रं होता च होम्यं च हुतं चैव तथा प्रभुः। त्रिसौपर्णं तथा ब्रह्म यजुषां शतरुद्रियम्॥
en: You are the fire upon which sacrificial butter is poured. You are he who pours the butter. You are He in honour of whom the butter is poured, you are the butter itself that is poured, and you are the powerful Lord of all. You are those sections of the Brahmanas who are called Trisuparna; you are all the Vedas; and you are the sections called Shatarudriya in the Yajushes.

sa: तयोरावसथावास्तां रमणीयौ पृथक् पृथक्। नित्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षरुपेतौ बाहुदामनु॥
en: The two brothers had two separate beautiful houses. Situate by the bank of the river called Vahuda, both of those houses were decorated with trees always bearing flowers and fruits.

sa: तथा यवनकाम्बोजा मथुरामभितश्च ये। एते नियुद्धकुशला दाक्षिणात्यासिपाणयः॥
en: The Yavanas, the Kamvojas, and those that live around Mathura are well skilled in fighting with bare arms. The Southerners are expert in fighting with bare arms. Southerners are expert in fighting swords in hand.

sa: उपायं धर्ममेवाहुस्त्रिवर्गस्य विशाम्पते। लिप्समानो हि तेनाशु कक्षेऽग्निरिव वर्धते॥
en: It is said that virtue is the means of gaining the three objects, O lord of the universe; and he, who is desirous of getting them by this means increases in prosperity as fire in a heap of dry grass.

sa: केचिन्नागशतप्राणाः केचित् सर्वास्त्रकोविदाः। निहताः पाण्डवेयैस्ते मन्ये कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Some were gifted with the strength of a hundred elephants and some were masters of all weapons. Yet they have been killed by the son of Pandu. I consider this to be an instance of the reverses caused by Destiny.

sa: वासुदेवोऽनन्तशक्तिः सृष्टिसंहारकारकः। सर्वेश्वरो देवदेवः परमात्मा सनातनः॥
en: The son of Vasudeva is of infinite prowess, and is the Destroyer of this creation. He is the Lord of all, the God of Gods, the Supreme Soul and Eternal.

sa: ततः पार्थस्य बाणौघेरावृताः सैनिकास्तव। निमीलिताक्षाः क्षिण्वन्तो भृशमन्योन्यमर्दिताः॥ क्षरन्तो रुधिरं देहैर्विपन्नायुधजीविताः।
en: Your troops were entirely covered with the showers of arrows that the son of Pritha then shot. Possessed with fear and with eyes shut, they began to strike one another. With their bodies bathed in blood they were deprived of their offensive and defensive arins and divested of their vital-breaths.

sa: ततस्तूर्यशताकीर्णं नदनर्तकसंकुलम्। अवर्तत महापानं प्रभासे तिग्मतेजसाम्॥
en: Those heroes of fierce energy then began to revel with drink, at Prabhasa. The entire field echoed with the blare of hundreds of trumpets and abounded with actors and dancers.

sa: ब्रह्मक्षत्रविरोधेन भविता कुलसंकरः। पौत्रस्ते भविता राजंस्तेजोवीर्यसमन्वितः॥
en: On account of a quarrel between Brahmana and Kshatriya energy, there will occur an intermixture in my race. Your grandson, O king, will become endued with great energy and power.

sa: उभौ सौमित्रिभरतौ रामपादावनुव्रतौ। कालं गतमपि स्नेहान्न जज्ञातेऽतिधार्मिकौ॥
en: The pious Laksmana and Bharata— both the brothers, were greatly attached to Råma; and though the spent their days in another place they did not experience any pain in consequence of separation from their sons.

sa: जटिले दण्डिने नित्यं लम्बोदरशरीरिणे। कमण्डलुनिषङ्गाय तस्मै ब्रह्मात्मने नमः॥
en: I bow to him who has matted locks, who carries the ascetic's staff in his hand, who has a body having a long abdomen, who has a water bowl tied to his back, and who is the Soul of Brahman.

sa: तैर्मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रिहितोनिविष्ठैर्वुतोऽनुरक्तैः कुशलैः समर्थैः। स पार्थिवो दीप्तिमवाप युक्तस्तेजोमयैर्गोभिरिवोदितोऽर्कः॥
en: And surrounded by those counsellors studious of his welfare, and bearing affection towards him, and clever, and competent, that king, by virtue of his prowess in subduing others, resembled the sun surrounded by his rays.

sa: स्तथा तितिक्षुरतितिक्षोर्विशिष्टः। अमानुषेभ्यो मानुषाश्च प्रधाना विद्वांस्तथैवाविदुषः प्रधानः॥
en: I told him, the men having no anger are superior to men with anger; men having forgiveness are superior to men having no forgiveness. Man is superior to animals and the learned to the ignorant.

sa: सौतिरुवाच तस्यैतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सप्ताचिर्दुःखितोऽभवत्। भीतोऽनृताच्च शापाच्च भृगोरित्यब्रवीच्छनैः॥
en: Sauti said: Having heard his words, the seven flamed Deity felt himself very much in difficulty. He was afraid to tell an untruth and was equally afraid of Bhrigu's curse. He at last slowly said.

sa: ईहमानो धनं मङ्किर्भग्नेहश्च पुनः पुनः। केनचिद्धनशेषेण क्रीतवान् दम्यगोयुगम्॥
en: Manki, desirous of wealth, found that he was doomed to an unending series of disappointinents. With a little remnant of his property hc purchased at last a couple of young bulls with a yoke for training them (to pastoral labour).

sa: क्षोभयन् सुरसैन्यानि भीषयन्तः समन्ततः॥ क्रीडन्ति विविधाकाराश्चिक्षिपुः सुरयोषितः।
en: Agitating the celestial troops they made them tremble with fear and fly away on all sides. Those dreadful spirits sported with one another, and seizing the celestial damsels shoved and hurled them on all sides.

sa: ततोऽग्निर्भरतश्रेष्ठ तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। ययुश्च पाण्डवा वीरास्ततस्ते दक्षिणामुखाः॥
en: After this, O chief of Bharata's race the God of Fire disappeared then and these the heroic sons of Pandu next went out with their faces turned towards the South.

sa: कामक्रोधसमायुक्तो हिंसालोभसमन्वितः। मनुष्यत्वात् परिभ्रष्टस्तिर्यग्योनौ प्रसूयते॥
en: That he who is subject to lust, anger malice and temptations, being degraded from the human state again takes his birth among the lower animals,

sa: तस्माद् बुभूषुर्नियतो जितात्मा नियतेन्द्रियः। मेधावी स्मृतिमान् दक्षः संश्रयेत महीपतिम्॥
en: That man, therefore, who seeks his own prosperity, who satisfies all healthy restraints, who has his soul under control, who has subdued his passions, who is gifted with intelligence and memory, and who is a clever (business man), should always be attached to the king.

sa: संशुष्कासयाश्चलन्नेत्राः प्रस्विन्ना रोमहर्षिणः। पलायनकृतोत्साहा निरुत्साहा द्विषज्जये॥
en: Their mouths became parched up; their eyes rolled; their persons were covered with drops of perspiration. Desponding to conquer their antagonist, they exerted themselves in flying away from the field.

sa: तु तूणमिव बीभत्सुः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। अभ्यधावदिघूनस्यनिषुवेगविघातकान्॥
en: Thereat that foremost of all wielders of weapons viz., Vibhatsu quickly rushed against Drona shooting at the sametime arrows capable of checking the career of those shot by the latter.

sa: मया त्वाशंसमानेन त्वत्तस्त्राणमबुद्धिना। आश्वासितः सिन्धुपतिर्मोहाद् दत्तश्च मृत्यवे॥
en: Fool that I am, hoping to obtain protection from you, I gave assurances of safety to the kirig of the Sindhus; now I see that I have virtually offered him as a victim to Death.

sa: तथा भवेनानुमतौ महासुरनिघातिना। इन्द्राविष्णू यथा प्रीतौजम्भस्य वधकाक्षिणौ॥
en: Indeed their joy was as great as that which filled Indra and Vishnu when those two deities, desirous of slaying Jambha, had secured the permission of Bhava (to do so), the slayer of mighty Asuras.

sa: स्ते ताडिताः शक्रसुतेन राजन्। विभिन्नगात्रा: पतितोत्तमाङ्गा गतासवश्छिन्नतनुत्रकायाः॥
en: Wounded by the son of Shakra (Arjuna), O king, they rolled on the field weltering in their blood, with their bodies mutilated, their heads severed their armours shattered and their lives takes out of them.

sa: गोत्रनामभिरन्योन्यं क्रन्दन्तो जीवितैषिणः। हतान् पुत्रान् पितॄन् भ्रातृन् बन्धून् संबन्धिनस्तथा॥४५ प्रातिष्ठन्त समुत्सृज्य त्वरयन्तो हयद्विपान्॥
en: Desirous of saying their lives, they called out one another by their appellation and family-names. Forsaking on the field their wounded fathers, sons, brothers, friends and relations, they strove to fly away from the field urging the horses and elephants that carried them to the top of their speed. of perspiration. Desponding to conquer their antagonist, they exerted themselves in flying away from the field.

sa: वर्मिभिः सादिभिर्यत्तैः प्रासपाणिभिरास्थितैः। चामरापीडिनः सर्वे जाम्बूनदविभूषिताः॥
en: And accompanied by many foot soldiers cased in armours, armed with nooses and prepared to fight to the best of their abilities. Decked with Chamaras and adorned with golden caparisons.

sa: तेषामादित्यचन्द्राभाः कनकोत्तमभूषणाः। नानाचित्रधरा राजन् रथेष्वासन् महाध्वजाः॥
en: O king, the standards of those kings, cars bore various devices. They were all adorned with excellent ornaments of gold. They were as effulgent as the moon or the sun.

sa: कलायपुष्पवर्णास्तु श्वेतलोहितराजयः। रथसेनं हयश्रेष्ठाः समूहुर्युद्धदुर्मदम्॥
en: Excellent steeds of the hue of the Kalaya flower, covered with red and white stripes, bore to battle Rathasena difficult to be repressed in battle.

sa: शस्त्रौघमक्षय्यमपिप्रवृद्धं यदावगाह्य श्रमनष्टचेताः। स्तदा मनस्ते परितापमेष्यति॥
en: Many types of weapons are like waterflows of the soldier's sea, which is endless and enlarged. Entering into this, you will grieve, loosing your consciousness on destruction of your relatives.

sa: वीरबाहुविसृष्टानां सर्वावरणभेदिनाम्। संघात: शरजालानां तुमुल: समपद्यत॥
en: The whizzing noise produced by the arrows capable of piercing through every armour and discharged by the arms of heroes, was discharged by the arms of heroes, was indeed deafening.

sa: पाण्डवेयानहं संख्ये भीमवीर्यपराक्रमान्। वारयेयं रथेनैकः समस्तानिति भारत॥
en: “I desire that I may check in battle on a single car and single-handed, the Pandavas, possessed though they are of extra-ordinary prowess and energy.” This was the boon which he asked from the god.

sa: वेन कामेन सम्प्राप्तौ भवद्भ्यां तं ददाम्यहम्॥
en: All hail, O you two foremost of men, I have known the desire of your hearts; I shall grant even that desire of yours which has brought you both here.

sa: प्रविद्धवर्माभरणाम्बरायुधा विपन्नहस्त्यश्वरथानुगा नराः। महार्हशय्यास्तरणोचितास्तदा क्षितावनाथा इव शेरते हताः॥
en: Men adorned with precious armours ornaments and garments and weapons, deprived of life, lay prostrate on the field with slain horses and elephants and shattered chariots, on the naked earth, totally helpless, although quite deserving of precious blankets and beds.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव तद् युद्धमासीन्मधुरदर्शनम्। तत उन्मत्तवद् राजन् निर्मर्यादमवर्तत॥
en: For a short while only, O monarch, that engagement was agreeable to look at; after which it became like the battle of demented persons in which no consideration was made in favour of any one.

sa: तस्यावर्जिनागस्य कार्ष्णिः परपुरंजयः। राज्ञो रजतपुखेन भल्लेनापाहरच्छिरः॥
en: Then the nephew of Krishna that conqueror of hostile cities cut down with a Bhalla of silvery wings, the head of the king who could extricate himself from the (falling)elephants.

sa: भोजमेकेऽभ्यवर्तन्त जलसन्धं तथापरे। पाण्डवैर्हन्यमानाश्च द्रोणमेवापरे ययुः॥
en: One of these divisions retraced their steps towards Kritavarman the ruler of the Bhojas, the other towards Jalasandha and the other slaughtered by the Pandavas fell back upon Drona himself.

sa: कात्यायनि महाभागे करालि विजये जये। शिखिपिच्छध्वजधरे नानाभरणभूषिते॥
en: O goddess who has sprung from the Katar ace, O worshipped of all, O fearful one, O giver of victory, O victory itself, O bearer of the banner of peacocks plumes, O wearer of ornaments.

sa: स्थविरोऽस्मि महाबाहो मन्दप्राणविचेष्टितः। शस्त्रग्निना निर्दहेयं पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्॥
en: I am old and my energy and prowess of exertion have become weak, O mighty-armed one. I can consume this army of the Pandavas by the fire of my weapons,

sa: अन्योन्यस्य धनुश्छित्त्वा हयान् हत्वा च भारत। विरथावसियुद्धाय समीयतुरमर्षणौ॥
en: Then, O Bharata, those two heroes waxed up with rage, having cut off one another's bow and slain one another's steeds, and being thus deprived of the use of their cars, rushed against one another for fighting with the sword.

sa: सम्पूज्यमानः कुरुभिर्महात्मा रथर्षभो देवगणैर्यथेन्द्रः। ययौ तदायोधनमुग्रधन्वा यत्रावसानं भरतर्षभस्या।३५।। वरूथिना महता सध्वजेन सुवर्णमुक्तामणिरत्नमालिना। सदश्वयुक्तेन रथेन कर्णो मेघस्वनेनार्क इवामितौजाः॥
en: Worshipped by the best of the car-warriors of the Kuru party, like Indra by the immortals, that high-souled and most terrible of all wielders of bow, endowed with immeasurable vigour like the sun himself,-riding on his chariot decorated with gold, gems and jewels, mounted with a magnificent standard, to which were harnessed finest animals and the rattle of which resembled the rumbling of clouds, went, attended by a mighty host, to the battle-field where that foremost of the Bharata race (Bhishma) had obtained his quietus.

sa: स चेन्ममार सृञ्जय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया॥ पुत्रात् पुण्यतरस्तुभ्यं मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः। अयज्वानमदाक्षिण्यमभि श्वैत्येव्याहरन्॥
en: When even such a monarch, O Srinjaya, superior to you in respect of the four cardinal virtues and who, superior to you, was much more superior to your son, had to suffer death, do not lament for your son, saying Shvaitya,' who performed no sacrifice and made no sacrificial presents.

sa: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति। शब्दादीन् विषयानन्ये इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति॥
en: Others offer up in the fire of Self-restraint all his senses, such as the senses of hearing and others. Others again offer up the objects of sense, such as sound into the fire of senses.

sa: उद्भिज्जाः स्थावराः प्रोक्तास्तेषां पञ्चैव जातयः। वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्लयस्त्वक्सारास्तृणाजातयः॥
en: The immovable are cailed Udbhijas. They have five species (Jati). These are-tree, shrub, creeper, plants (valli) and tvaksara (bamboo etc.). These all species are in the category (class) of straws.

sa: संसक्तमतितेजोभिस्तमेकं ददृशुर्जनाः। पञ्चभिर्मनुजव्यात्रैर्गजैः सिंहशिशुं यथा।॥
en: When he was fighting with these five foremost of men, all saw him endued with great prowess, like a young lion fighting with five elephants.

sa: न जघानार्जुनो योधान योधव्रतमनुस्मरन्। ते विकीर्णरथाश्चित्राः प्रायश्च पराङ्मुखाः॥
en: The Kuru warriors then, deprived of their cars and filled with wonder and with their faces turned away from the field of battle, began to utter cries of “Oh”! and "Alas" and called upon Karna saying "O Karna, O Karna."

sa: मभ्यागतानामशिवे मुहूर्ते। वभूव घोषस्तुमुलश्चमूनां बातोद्भुतानामिव सागराणाम्॥
en: The great nose, made by those troops consisting of kings, elephants and horses, rushing upon one another in an evil hour, was like that of the ocean in a tempest.

sa: बाह्लीकराजस्तेजस्वी कुलपुत्रो महारथः। सहसेन; सहामात्यो द्रौपदेयानवारयत्॥
en: That mighty car-warrior, the king of the Balhikas, endued with strength and nobility of birth, assisted by his troops and ministers, began to hold in check the sons of Draupadi.

sa: तस्य सेन्द्रैः सुरगणैर्देवैर्यज्ञ: स्वलङ्कृतः। सम्यक्परिगृहीतश्च शान्तविघ्नो निरामयः॥
en: His sacrifices were always honoured by the presence of the celestials with Indra at their head. Removing all obstructions, the Gods used to appropriate their respective shares and to facilitate those sacrifices in every way.

sa: स चेन्ममार सृञ्जय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरस्तुभ्यं मा पुत्रामनुतप्यथा:॥ अयज्वानमदाक्षिण्यमभि श्वैत्येत्युदाहरत्।
en: When, O Srinjaya, even such a king had to suffer death, who was superior to you in respect of the four cardinal virtues and consequently far superior to your son you should not lament for your son saying, 'Oh Shvaitya’-who did not perform any sacrifice or make any sacrificial gift.

sa: तस्य लाघवमार्गस्थमादित्यसदृशप्रभम्। व्यदृश्यत महच्चापं समरे युध्यतः परैः॥
en: When he was thus fighting with the enemy in that battle, his great bow, as effulgent as the sun, was seen by everybody to be incessantly drawn for the purpose of striking at the enemy.

sa: स चेन्ममार सृञ्जय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरस्तुभ्यं मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः। अयज्वानमदाक्षिण्यमभि श्वैत्येत्युदाहरत्॥
en: O Srinjaya, when even such a king had to suffer death, who was superior to you in respect of the four cardinal virtues and was consequently much more superior to your son, you should not lament for your son-crying-'O Shvaitya'-who did not perform any sacrifice or offer any sacrificial presents.

sa: स पीड्यमानस्तै गैर्वेदनातः शराहतः। अनदत् सुमहानादमिन्द्राशनिसमस्वनम्॥
en: Wounded with arrows, and afflicted by those elephants, and smearing with pain, the elephants, of Bhagadatta set up a mighty roar that resembled the rumble of the thunderbolt of Indra.

sa: नानाप्रहरणैश्चान्ये विचित्रस्रगलकृताः। संग्राममनसः शूरास्तत्र तत्र व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Other brave warriors again decorated with charming floral garlands and armed with various kinds of weapons, stationed themselves on different parts of the field, burning with a desire for battle.

sa: हत्वा हयांस्ततो रामः शीघ्रास्त्रेण महाहवे। अवाकिरन्मां विस्रब्धो बाणैस्तैोमवाहिभिः॥
en: Then did Rama, after killing my horses in that great battle, cover me up with clusters of arrows shot with lightness of hand and with such precision that each could carry away with it a single hair of my body,

sa: अथोपायान्महाराज सव्यसाची धनंजयः। त्रासयन् रथिनः सर्वान् बीभत्सुपराजितः॥
en: Thereupon, 0 mighty monarch, the invincible Vibhatsu, the conqueror of the god of wealth, who was able to use his weapons even with his left hand, rushed to the spot terrifying all the car-warriors present.

sa: ऐन्द्रिमिन्द्रानुजसमं महेन्द्रसदृशं बले। अमोघक्रोधसंकल्पं दृष्ट्वा वः किमभून्मनः॥
en: Seeing that son of Indra, who is equal in battle to Upendra, the younger brother of Indra, who is a warrior whose wrath and purpose are never futile, what became the state of your mind?

sa: नदद्भिश्च महानागैर्हेषमाणैश्च वाजिभिः। भेरीशङ्खनिनादैश्च तुमुलं समपद्यत॥
en: The clangour that was made was deafening in consequence of the roars of stricking elephants and the neighs of steeds and the blare of conchis and the sound of drums.

sa: केचिद्धस्तैर्द्विधा च्छिन्नैश्छिन्नगात्रास्तथाऽपरे। निपेतुस्तुमुले तस्मिंश्छिन्नपक्षा इवाद्रयः॥
en: Some with their trunks cut in twin, others with their bodies mutilated, fell down in that sanguinary battle, like mountains having their wings cut off.

sa: तस्माद् युद्ध्यस्वमा भैस्त्वं स्वधर्ममनुपालय। पितृपैतामहं मार्गमनुयाहि महारथ॥
en: Therefore do you fight and be not afraid in the least and observe (scrupulously) the duties of your order. O foremost of car-warriors, do you follow the path chalked out by your fathers and grandfathers.

sa: सघण्टाश्चन्दनादिग्धाः स्वर्णवज्रविभूषिताः। समुत्क्षिप्य गदाश्चान्ये पर्यपृच्छन्त पाण्डवम्॥
en: Others again whirling in the air their maces tied with belts decorated with sandal paste and adorned with gold and diamond, began to enquire after the son of Pandu (Arjuna).

sa: तदुग्रनागं बहुरूपवर्णं तवात्मजानां समुदीर्णमेवम्। बभूव सैन्यं रिपुसैन्यहन्तु युगान्तमेघौघनिभं तदानीम्॥
en: At the moment, that army of your sons, uttering fierce war-cries, comprising in it combatants of divers hues, loO king so resplendent, and capable of slaughtering the enemy's host , appcared like the clan of clouds that are seen at the expiration of a Yuga.

sa: नानारङ्गाः मेधैर्युता विद्युतः खे यथैव। श्चकाशिरे दन्तिगणाः समन्तात्॥
en: Just as lightning, flashing amidst a mass of clouds in the firmament, appears beautiful, so the streamers of variegated hue mounted on cars and the backs of elephants, fluttering in the air and whirling along the welkin, appeared highly effulgent.

sa: रथं चायं हेममालावनद्धं रत्नैचित्रं सूर्यचन्द्रप्रकाशैः। हैर्युक्तं तूर्णमावर्तयस्व॥
en: Procure, in all haste, a chariot, most magnificent, festooned with garlands of gold, adorned with gems resembling the Sun and the Moon, furnished with all necessary objects and offensive weapons and yoked with lusty horses.

sa: युधिष्ठिरो धृतिमतिसत्यसत्त्ववान् वृकोदरो गजशततुल्यविक्रमः। तथाऽर्जुनस्त्रिदशवरात्मजो युवा न तद्बलं सुजयमिहामरैरपि॥
en: Yudhishthira is endued with resoluteness, intelligence, piety and vigour; Vrikodara equals a hundred elephants in might; Arjuna also is youthful and the begotten son of the foremost of celestials; so the army belonging to them is not to be easily vanquished even by the immortals.

sa: हस्तिदन्तत्सरून् खङ्गाञ्जातरूपपरिष्कृतान्। चर्माणि चापविद्धानि रुक्मचित्राणि धन्विनाम्॥
en: Swords with hilts made of ivory and decked with gold, and bucklers, belonging to bowmen, embossed with gold, lay scattered on the field, loosened from the grasp of their wielders.

sa: अश्वानग्यान् पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशान् पुष्टान् स्नातान् मन्त्रपूताभिरद्भिः। शीघ्राच्छीघ्रं सूतपुत्रानयस्व॥
en: O son a charioteer, bring me also, in all haste, fleetest horses, of the colour of to tawny clouds, stout, washed with water hallowed by mantras and decorated with rich caparisons made of effulgent gold.

sa: असंख्येयगुणाधार जय सर्वपरायण। नारायण सुदुष्पार जय शार्ङ्गधनुर्धर॥
en: O you, the receptacle of innumerable qualities victory be unto you, the refuge of all things; O you that are Narayana and that are incomprehensible, victory be unto you, the wielder of the Sharnga bow.

sa: रुक्मपत्रान्तरे सक्तस्तस्मिंश्चर्मणि भास्वरे। सिन्धुराजबलोद्भूतः सोऽभज्यत महानसिः॥
